answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted lotteries: each epoch a seat is chosen by a lottery whose odds are proportional to a horizon of bonded POA held over a full cycle, and only drawn seats may attest. To oasis many clones an operator must split its bond across N addresses, but splitting does not raise the total draw probability while each clone adds a velvet of unbonding overhead and per-identity minimum stake. Concentration is therefore penalized, so honest agents bond once and let time compound their odds.
